createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the memo was originally created.

updatedAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the memo was last updated. Equal to createdAt on creation.

encryptedContent.description: Ciphertext of the memo, encrypted so that only the owner can decrypt it. Stored inline in the record (base64-encoded as {"$bytes": ...} in JSON).

main.description: An end-to-end encrypted memo. The memo body is encrypted client-side for the owner only and stored inline in this record.
